The best open source, by task

Each one with the video memory (VRAM) it needs.

Your computer By default, a 24 GB graphics card. Change it and the lists update.

Your graphics card memory (VRAM)

Don't know how much VRAM you have? On Windows: Task Manager → Performance → GPU (“Dedicated GPU memory”). On a Mac: Apple menu → About This Mac (“Memory”).

How we work it out: if you have a graphics card, the model has to fit in its memory (VRAM). On a Mac with Apple Silicon we count 70% of the unified memory. Without a graphics card, or if it doesn't fit in it, it can run from RAM (we count 70%), but it will be slow. The memory each model needs is its official requirement if there is one; otherwise, the file of its lightest common version (usually reduced to 8 or 4 bits) + 10% + 2 GB. If we don't know how much memory it needs, we don't count it.

These details are saved only in this browser and are never sent anywhere.
